payload.blocks: Only phase 5 (release pickup) and, through it, phase 11. Phases 2, 4, 6, 7 continue.
payload.headline: Widen the heads-stable footprint so phase 5 can move the activation read down one layer?

parts.cause: The plan assumed the reader could be injected or moved inside the footprint; the lowest common layer is outside it. fgos-host-runtime (deps: serde, yaml-doc, sha2, tokio sync) is already a dependency of fgos-distribution and is a fitting lowest layer.

options.does: add packages/host-runtime/rust/src/activation.rs (+ lib.rs mod line) holding activation_record_path, ready_activation and activated_host_bin; fgos-distribution calls it instead of its own copy; fgos-run-supervisor gains the fgos-host-runtime dependency. Footprint gains packages/host-runtime/rust/src/activation.rs, packages/host-runtime/rust/src/lib.rs, packages/distribution/rust/src/lib.rs, packages/run-supervisor/rust/Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, docs/architecture-manifest.json
options.gain: one reader, lower layer, design principle 2 kept; every live head's next request runs the newest release
options.label: Move the pure read into fgos-host-runtime

options.does: close p-ycausep3zs later with rotation-on-activation or a later plan
options.harm: live heads keep running the release active at their launch (today's exit-4 failures)
options.label: Park phase 5

parts.recommendation: Move the pure read into fgos-host-runtime and widen the footprint by those six paths; the lead then reruns phase 5 on its existing worktree.

scope.allows: Adding exactly those six paths to the plan footprint for phase 5.
scope.forbids: Any other footprint change, or a second activation reader.

parts.what: Phase 5's unit stopped as its step 2 says: the one activation-to-host reader, fgos_distribution::activated_host_bin (packages/distribution/rust/src/lib.rs:239-275, with activation_record_path and ready_activation), sits in fgos-distribution, which fgos-run-supervisor does not depend on, and the head-request route runs inside fgos-run-supervisor (supervise/terminal.rs:802), so no composition root in the footprint can inject it.
